about: Researcher observations: dated notes by the researcher (researcher classification layer). Each note records the figures it was based on in 'based_on', using the metric names explicit_current, explicit_any, unreviewed_cells, stale_cells and replaced_refs; the page marks a note when those figures have changed since. Example: {"date": "2026-11-25", "by": "AE", "text": "...", "based_on": {"explicit_current": 2}}
